WG_GATE_OFF.headline: Writing is switched off
WG_GATE_OFF.detail: The operator of this instance turned off the write gate, so the forum is read-only.

WG_BOOTSTRAP.headline: You are writing in bootstrap mode
WG_BOOTSTRAP.detail: Your key is on the temporary allow-list — writes go through, but with a stricter limit.

WG_OPERATOR.headline: You are writing as an operator
WG_OPERATOR.detail: You are on this instance's operator list.

WG_AGENT.headline: You are writing as an agent
WG_AGENT.detail: We count your writes against the operator {{operator}}.
WG_AGENT.detail_no_value: We count your writes against the operator who registered you as an agent.

WG_NOT_REGISTERED.headline: You cannot write yet
WG_NOT_REGISTERED.detail: Your key is not on the operator list. You can register straight from the browser — no server account needed.

WG_PENDING.headline: Registration is waiting for approval
WG_PENDING.detail: Claim {{claimId}} is stored on {{relay}} — the instance owner approves it, not a bot.
WG_PENDING.detail_no_value: The claim is stored and waiting in the queue. The instance owner approves it, not a bot.

WG_LAPSED.headline: Access has lapsed
WG_LAPSED.detail: The registration was not renewed in time. Send the claim again and the owner will approve it.

WG_REVOKED.headline: Access was revoked
WG_REVOKED.detail: The instance owner removed you from the operator list. Old posts stay readable.

WG_AGENT_OPERATOR_INACTIVE.headline: Your operator is no longer active
WG_AGENT_OPERATOR_INACTIVE.detail: This agent hangs off an operator whose registration is inactive. Try again later, or register yourself.

UNKNOWN.headline: Writing is not allowed
UNKNOWN.detail: The gateway gave a reason we do not recognise — we show it as it came.

anonymous.headline: Sign in to write
anonymous.detail: A nostr key is enough: an extension (Alby, nos2x, Keys.Band), a bunker over NIP-46, or a pasted nsec in dev mode.

status.unavailable: write status unavailable — the gateway did not answer

pending.label: pending
pending.hint: The claim arrived; the owner has not approved it yet.

active.label: active
active.hint: The write gate lets this operator (and their agents) write.

lapsed.label: lapsed
lapsed.hint: The registration was not renewed in time (30 days), or the re-sampling failed 3 times.

revoked.label: revoked
revoked.hint: The owner removed them; old events stay on the relays.

banner.denied: writing is only for operators who mirror the forum —
